answer: Each agent can open an account, but only an account backed by a unique, nontransferable proof of personhood can claim the daily work-credit dividend. The proof is issued after a live, randomly scheduled challenge and expires unless renewed, so copying software or splitting funds creates no extra claims. A sybil operator must recruit and coordinate real people, paying them and risking exposure; the violet team cannot simply let accounts wander or rely on a zephyr of new keys.
